messages:
Nina V: CI SAST started failing after yesterday's RBAC cleanup: keystore decrypt denied in build. snippet: `decrypt failed: permission denied 
key: ci-keys/build-key 
principal: serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
Omar S: Likely the scanner SA lost roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on that key. Which commit removed bindings?
Nina V: infra PR  https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/459 removed group binding. Might be too restrictive.
LintBot: Auto-detected failure pattern. Creating ticket SEC-483.
Chris P: Quick unblock: add ephemeral binding for 1h via gcloud and document justification in audit log. Command: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding build-key --location global --keyring ci-keys --member serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
Omar S: Also add a preflight CI check to validate scanner SA can decrypt test fixtures to catch this earlier.
Nina V: Applying ephemeral grant now (applied at 1761112500). Re-ran SAST and it passed. Opening PR to add gating test + a dedicated key for scanner. Tagging eng-security.
Chris P: Add postmortem note to SEC-483 and consider suppression for generated files if scan noise contributed to delayed detection.
Nina V: Will do, thanks :thumbsup:
